Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while the patient's vehicle was turning left, with resulting right
shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force
of the impact described. No prior injury to the same body area is known to this provider. Over the course of care the
patient attended 22 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of shoulder injury. Physical
examination revealed findings that support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including limited abduction and
tenderness over the rotator cuff region, while several other tests, including neurological screening and strength
testing of the upper extremity, returned normal results. Treatment consisted of guided physical therapy, a home
exercise program, and anti-inflammatory medication. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no duplicated or
repeated charges for services. Current status is improving, with continued monitoring and a plan for reassessment at
the next scheduled visit.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
